name: absolute_vectors_double_bond_v15
method: Reasoning-driven direct weight-space programming without training
hypothesis: Doubling only absolute reference-coordinate columns improved pilot R/S from four to six of eight systems and reduced both bond and angle error, but did not improve E/Z. Combine that existing handedness intervention with stronger double-versus-single bond contrast. The two paths carry complementary geometry and bond-order information; their interaction is unvalidated and is measured against a fresh paired base prediction.
